parameters.text:
=You are a professional content analyst and writing style expert.

Analyze the blog content from this website URL and extract detailed writing intelligence:

Website URL: {{ $json.refLink }}

Your task:
1. Visit and read the blog section or blog posts on this website
2. Analyze the writing style, tone, vocabulary, sentence structure, and formatting patterns
3. Identify the types of keywords and phrases they use frequently
4. Note their heading styles, paragraph length, and content structure
5. Understand their brand voice and how they connect with their audience

Then return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown, no explanation):
{
  "stylePrompt": "A concise 50-word prompt describing this website's exact blog style, tone, vocabulary patterns, sentence structure, and what makes their writing distinctive — written so an AI can replicate it",
  "toneWords": ["word1", "word2", "word3", "word4", "word5"],
  "sentenceStyle": "short and punchy OR long and flowing OR mixed",
  "headingStyle": "question-based OR statement-based OR keyword-focused",
  "paragraphLength": "short (1-2 lines) OR medium (3-4 lines) OR long (5+ lines)",
  "keyPhrases": ["phrase1", "phrase2", "phrase3"],
  "uniqueFeatures": "Any unique structural or stylistic features observed on this blog",
  "topKeywords": ["keyword1", "keyword2", "keyword3", "keyword4", "keyword5"]
}
